verdict.rationale: The docs say API credentials are generated under Settings > Access Management > API Credentials, where you can configure their permissions and an optional expiry date. Endpoint reference pages name per-operation permissions (e.g., "Monitor and unmonitor customers", "View roles in account"), which suggests fine-grained, least-privilege scoping is possible for credentials an agent would use. Missing for 10: a documented catalog showing how granular credential permissions are, explicit mapping of credential permissions to individual endpoints, and any independent or hands-on confirmation that scoped credentials enforce restrictions.
